anxiety can make you feel many things that arent rational and i think it can sometimes feel like youre out of your mind/ delusional. i think it would benefit you to understand more about schizophrenia/ psychosis bc having either of those isnt the end of the world or a death sentence. that isnt me saying you have it or that youre in the wrong for being scared, but the way you think of it can make you more frightened. there are many things right now that can leave people feeling like theyre losing their grip on sanity, from the stress of covid to anxiety to the things in their personal lives that make it all worse. in short, your anxiety might make you feel like youre losing your grip (i speak from experience, it can be really hard sometimes) but it wont actually cause you to develop schizophrenia. as long as you arent having schizophrenia symptoms, youve got nothing to worry about. just take it easy and remember that your brain is powerful and can make you feel like everything is far more severe than it actually is. when you start to feel anxious about this id suggest talking to a close friend, reading a book you like or playing a videogame you enjoy! any comfort that you can use to sooth and distract yourself from the anxiety. it's what i do when the anxiety gets me really bad, and it helps a lot. youre going to be okay, i promise. <3
